description: Get a wallet's aggregate metrics: volume, inflow, outflow, net flow, tx count, tokens traded across time windows (24h/7d/30d/90d/all). Without `chain` it answers for the more recently active of ethereum and bsc, and for base or hyperevm only when the wallet has no priced ethereum/bsc volume; the result's `chain` says which.

chain.description: Answer for this chain only (default: see the tool description)

name: wallet_summary
title: Wallet Summary
